# `mapSomeToAsSome`

Suggests using Effect.asSome instead of Effect.map when the mapper only wraps the success value with Option.some

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377114` |
| Language Service name | `mapSomeToAsSome` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/map-some-to-as-some` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect, Option } from "effect"

const numberEffect = Effect.succeed(1)

export const pipeable = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map(Option.some)
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(map-some-to-as-some): `Effect.asSome` expresses wrapping the success value in `Option.some` directly.
*/
)

export const etaExpanded = numberEffect.pipe(
  Effect.map((value) => Option.some(value))
/**
  ^^^^^^^^^^
*/
)

export const dataFirst = Effect.map(numberEffect, Option.some)
/**
                         ^^^^^^^^^^
*/
```
